metaTitle: Best Lazy Susans for Bathrooms in 2026
metaDescription: Five bathroom lazy susans compared by size, tiers and material, from a 9 inch clear stack to a 10 inch six compartment organizer for vanities.
introParagraphs: Bathroom counters fill up quickly with creams, perfumes, hair tools and medicine bottles, and the item you want is always at the back. A lazy susan turns that pile into something you can reach with one finger, which matters when bending or stretching first thing in the morning is not as easy as it used to be. We compared five turntables made for vanities, cabinets and counters.

The spread is real. The LAMU is a 9 inch clear organizer that builds into one or two tiers, the Dezzer is a 10 inch round unit with six compartments, and the YCLADEC set gives you two 11.5 inch turntables in one pack. The Acina stacks three clear tiers, while the Anyoifax is a small ABS tray for skincare and lotions.

We evaluated each pick based on product specs and buyer feedback, paying attention to footprint, edge height, how wet bottles are handled and how smoothly each one turns. The sections below explain which design fits a narrow vanity, a deep under sink cabinet or a crowded dresser, rather than just handing you a ranking.

products.name: LAMU 2 Tier Rotating Makeup Organizer
products.description:
The LAMU is the most adaptable turntable in this group because its layers are modular. You can run it as a single flat tray on a narrow vanity or build it into two tiers when you need to lift bottles higher. The listing also says a second unit can be stacked on top, so the footprint stays the same while capacity grows.

The built in ball bearings are what make the spin quiet and smooth, and that is the feature we care about most for anyone with a weaker grip. A clear look helps you see skincare and perfume bottles from the side without moving anything. The tradeoff is the 9 inch width, which is the smallest clear tray here, so a large collection of tall bottles will feel crowded.

Setup is a snap together job with no tools, and cleaning is a wipe with a damp cloth. Next to the Acina, the LAMU gives up the third level but is easier to fit under a mirror cabinet or shelf. Compared with the Dezzer it has no dividers, so small items like lipsticks need a separate tray if you want them sorted.
products.bestFor: Narrow vanities where you want flexible height
pros: Modular layers work as one or two tiers
Ball bearings spin quietly and smoothly
Second unit can be stacked for more height
Compact 9 inch footprint suits tight counters
cons: No built in dividers for small items
9 inch width crowds a big collection

products.name: Dezzer 10 Inch Clear Makeup Turntable
products.description:
The Dezzer is the pick for anyone whose counter clutter is mostly small things. It has six individual compartments, a multi section divider and a drop in tray, so lip products, brushes, bottles and jars each get a home. The listing gives exact dimensions of 10 by 10 by 3.5 inches, which makes it easy to check against your counter before ordering.

The 10 inch round base is a wide footprint and the seller itself reminds buyers to measure first. That warning is fair, because this is not a unit for a thin shelf. The low 3.5 inch profile does mean it slides under many mirror cabinets, but tall pump bottles will not stand inside it comfortably.

There is no assembly beyond dropping in the inner tray, and cleaning means lifting out the divider and wiping each section. Compared with the LAMU, the Dezzer holds smaller items better but offers no second tier. Against the Anyoifax, it is wider and more organized, so choose it when sorting matters more than saving space.
products.bestFor: Sorting lipsticks, brushes and small jars on a vanity
pros: Six compartments keep small items sorted
Drop in tray adds a flexible section
Exact 10 x 10 x 3.5 in size is easy to plan
Silent rotation suits early morning use
cons: 10 inch footprint is wide for narrow shelves

products.name: Acina 3 Tier Clear Rotating Organizer
products.description:
The Acina is the vertical option, stacking three clear levels on one turning base. That lets you sort perfume, skincare and hair products by tier and see everything at a glance because the plastic is transparent. The decorative diamond pattern on the trays is a pleasant touch, and the no skid surface helps keep bottles in place as the stack turns.

The tradeoff is height and stability. Three tiers need more vertical space than a mirror cabinet usually allows, so this belongs on an open counter or a dresser. The listing does not give exact dimensions in the details we reviewed, so measure your space against the seller's size chart before buying, and put the heaviest bottles on the bottom level.

Assembly is a quick stack and cleaning is a damp cloth, though the diamond grooves can trap a little residue that you will want to wipe out occasionally. Compared with the LAMU's two tier build, this holds more but sits taller and less stably. Against the YCLADEC pair, you get vertical storage instead of two flat trays, so decide based on whether your problem is height or footprint.
products.bestFor: Open counters with plenty of headroom and many products
pros: Three levels hold far more in one footprint
Clear plastic lets you spot products quickly
No skid surface steadies bottles while turning
Diamond pattern hides light scratches
cons: Too tall for most mirror cabinets
Top heavy if the upper tiers are overloaded

products.name: YCLADEC 2 Pack 11.5 Inch Turntables
products.description:
The YCLADEC set gives you two 11.5 inch turntables in one box, so you can put one in the bathroom cabinet and another on the vanity. Neither needs tools or installation, you simply set them down and they spin through 360 degrees. The closed bottom is the standout detail for a bathroom, because the listing says it suits wet items and will not leak onto the shelf below.

These are plain single level trays, so you do not get extra height, and the listing does not state a weight rating. At 11.5 inches each is wide for a narrow cabinet, but that same width lets a tray hold a lot of bottles side by side. Think of it as a practical workhorse rather than a showpiece.

Cleaning is simple because the surface is smooth and the bottom is closed, so spills stay on the tray where you can wipe them. Compared with the LAMU, you give up modular tiers but gain a second unit for the same shopping trip. Against the Dezzer, you trade compartments for open space, which suits taller bottles and wet containers better.
products.bestFor: Cabinets and counters where you need two simple trays
pros: Two 11.5 inch trays in one pack
No tools or installation needed
Closed bottom suits wet bottles
Smooth spin reaches back items
cons: Single level adds no extra height
Wide footprint is awkward in narrow cabinets

products.name: Anyoifax Small Skincare Turntable
products.description:
The Anyoifax is the small, plain pick for a skincare shelf or a bedside spot. It is made from ABS plastic, which the listing describes as sturdy for long term use, and the surface is smooth enough to wipe clean in seconds. Because it needs no installation, you can set it down and start using it right away.

The small size is both the appeal and the limit. It handles lotions, serums, small perfumes and hair tools, but a family bathroom with large bottles will outgrow it fast. The listing does not give a precise diameter in the details we reviewed, so check the size chart before you buy.

Cleaning is as easy as wiping the tray with a damp cloth. Compared with the LAMU, you do not get tiers or stacking, just a single level that does one thing well. Against the Dezzer, you lose the compartments, so pick this one when you want simple access and the smallest possible footprint.
products.bestFor: A single skincare or perfume shelf with limited space
pros: Small footprint fits tight shelves
ABS surface wipes clean quickly
No installation or tools required
Turns smoothly to show every bottle
cons: No tiers or compartments for sorting
Too small for a big family collection

buyingCriteria.criterion: Measure the counter and cabinet first
buyingCriteria.explanation: A lazy susan only works if the full circle can turn without hitting a wall, a faucet or a mirror cabinet shelf. The Dezzer is 10 inches across and 3.5 inches tall, while the YCLADEC trays are 11.5 inches each, so they need noticeably more width than the 9 inch LAMU. Measure the clearance inside the cabinet, not just the door opening, because the shelf behind the door is often shallower. A good rule is to leave at least an inch of space around the tray so the rotation never catches a bottle on the edge.

buyingCriteria.criterion: Choose edge height for the bottle size
buyingCriteria.explanation: A low rim keeps heavy jars from sliding off while the tray spins, but it also limits what can stand upright. The Dezzer stands only 3.5 inches overall and uses compartments to hold things in place, while the Acina relies on a no skid surface across three levels. If you own tall pump bottles, avoid the low profile trays and favor the flat LAMU or YCLADEC. Weight on the outer edge is the likely wobble point, so keep the heaviest items near the center.

buyingCriteria.criterion: Look at bearing quality and smooth rotation
buyingCriteria.explanation: Ball bearings make a turntable spin quietly with a light touch, which helps anyone with a weaker grip reach items without leaning in. The LAMU lists built in ball bearings, and the Dezzer is described as rotating smoothly and silently, while the YCLADEC and Anyoifax simply advertise a smooth 360 degree spin. Steel bearings are common and durable, while aluminum is marketed as smoother. Remember that seller weight claims have no common test standard, so keep loads well below any stated limit.

Open trays like the YCLADEC suit tall bottles and spills, while compartments like the six on the Dezzer keep small items from rolling together. The Acina splits your products by tier, which is another way to sort. Decide based on what you actually store: lipsticks and brushes benefit from sections, while shampoo and spray bottles do not. A mixed collection often does best with one open tray plus one sorted tray.

buyingCriteria.criterion: Check how the material handles moisture
buyingCriteria.explanation: Bathrooms are humid and bottles leak, so the material matters more here than in a pantry. The Anyoifax uses ABS plastic with a surface that wipes clean, and the YCLADEC has a closed bottom that the listing says suits wet items. The Acina and LAMU are clear plastic styles that will not warp the way untreated wood can. Avoid porous materials in a bathroom, and wipe the tray weekly so soap residue and perfume spills do not build up.

The best turntable is the one you can reach without a stool. A three tier unit like the Acina brings the top level up to a height that may be hard to reach from a seated position or a low shelf, while the single level Anyoifax or YCLADEC stays at hand. Place the most used items on the front half of the tray so a quarter turn brings them to you. If bending is hard, put the turntable on the counter instead of the lowest cabinet shelf.

howWeEvaluated.title: Footprint and fit
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared each listing's stated size, from the 9 inch LAMU to the 11.5 inch YCLADEC trays. Footprint matters most in a bathroom where counter space is scarce. Picks with clear dimensions scored higher than those with vague sizing, so the Anyoifax lost a little here.

howWeEvaluated.title: Rotation and stability
howWeEvaluated.description: We looked at how each pick describes its bearing and surface, since smooth rotation is the main reason to buy a lazy susan. The LAMU lists ball bearings and the Dezzer describes silent rotation, while others only claim a smooth spin. We also considered whether edges or a no skid surface stop bottles from sliding.

howWeEvaluated.title: Organization features
howWeEvaluated.description: We checked what each pick offers beyond a flat tray, such as the Dezzer's six compartments, the Acina's three levels and the LAMU's modular layers. More structure is only an advantage if it matches what you store. We rewarded flexible designs that handle both small items and tall bottles.

howWeEvaluated.title: Moisture and cleaning
howWeEvaluated.description: A bathroom tray gets splashed, so we noted closed bottoms, plastic surfaces and wipe clean finishes. The YCLADEC's closed bottom and the Anyoifax's ABS surface were the clearest strengths. Textured surfaces like the Acina's diamond pattern need a little more attention when wiping.

howWeEvaluated.title: Strongest versus most basic pick
howWeEvaluated.description: We compared the LAMU, with its modular tiers, ball bearings and stacking option, against the Anyoifax, which is a plain small tray with no extras. The LAMU earns its Best Overall spot through flexibility, while the Anyoifax makes sense only when space and simplicity matter most. Value and ease of use were weighed alongside the feature gap.

howToChoose.subheading: By Where You Will Use It

rows: Narrow vanity with a mirror above
Open dresser with lots of height

cards.label: Single level
cards.text: The YCLADEC, Dezzer and Anyoifax use one flat level, which fits under mirror cabinets and keeps every bottle in easy reach. They are steadier because there is no tall stack to wobble. Choose these if your shelf has limited height.

cards.label: Multiple tiers
cards.text: The Acina offers three levels and the LAMU builds into one or two, doubling or tripling storage in one footprint. They need headroom and care with heavy items. Recommendation: pick tiers if you have open space above the counter, and a single level if you do not.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A turntable that spins with one finger and sits at counter height so you never reach over the back edge. Skip tall stacks if you stand at a low sink.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The LAMU suits best, with ball bearings and a compact 9 inch footprint. The Anyoifax is the easier reach for one shelf of skincare.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You have many products and the counter has room. The Acina adds vertical capacity and the Dezzer adds organization that a plain tray cannot match.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You only need a tidy spot for a few bottles. The LAMU and Anyoifax keep costs down while still turning smoothly.

faq.q: How do I choose between a 2 tier and a 3 tier bathroom lazy susan?
faq.a: Start with the height of the space. The Acina stacks three levels, so it needs open headroom, while the LAMU can be run as one or two tiers and fits under a mirror cabinet more easily. If you own many small products and have a clear counter, the three tier gives more capacity. Otherwise the two tier is steadier and easier to reach.

faq.q: Which type is best for a narrow vanity?
faq.a: The LAMU is the narrowest clear option at 9 inches wide, and its layers can be stacked to add height without adding width. The Anyoifax is also small, though its exact diameter is not stated in the listing. Measure your counter and leave an inch of clearance so the tray can turn freely.

They sit across a wide range, from the lowest-cost LAMU and Anyoifax to the premium Acina. Mid-range choices like the YCLADEC include two trays, which often works out to better value per tray. Check the current price on Amazon before deciding, since it changes often.

faq.q: How do I keep a bathroom turntable clean?
faq.a: Wipe it weekly with a damp cloth, and lift out dividers like the Dezzer's tray so you can clean each section. The YCLADEC's closed bottom keeps spills on the tray, which makes wiping easier. Avoid soaking, and dry the tray so soap film does not build up in humid air.

faq.q: Does a lazy susan work in an under sink cabinet?
faq.a: It can, but plumbing pipes often block the rotation, so measure the clearance around the drain before buying. A closed bottom tray like the YCLADEC is the safer pick because leaks and drips stay contained. If the pipes sit in the middle, a flat tray placed to the side may work better than a round one.

faq.q: Will tall bottles tip over on a spinning tray?
faq.a: They can if the tray has a low edge and you spin quickly. Keep tall bottles near the center, put heavy items on the bottom tier of a multi tier unit, and turn the tray gently. The Acina's no skid surface and the Dezzer's compartments help hold items in place.
